a listen line saying which brief-style targets (attack window, centroid range) are met
what_worked: footstep surface=grass shoe=sneaker met the brief at once: attack 31 ms, no pitch, centroid ~4 kHz, 0.52 s
macros on footstep weight/swish plus a lp filter freq all passed their claims
listen descriptors (swell/attack headline, centroid by tenth) were enough to check the brief without guessing
notes: Measured: unfiltered default step centroid 3.96k Hz (start 3.99k), swell/attack 31 ms, pitch none, length 0.52 s, peak -1.5. With the lp tone filter (macro brightness 0.6) centroid 2.1-2.5k Hz, swell 39 ms (close to the 40 ms edge), length 0.53 s. verify defaults + 3 macro claims all PASS. Exported 4 variations (peaks -1.0 to -2.6 dBFS, LUFS -20.0 to -20.3). Peak of seed 3 is 1.6 dB lower than the others; acceptable. Footstep has two onsets (heel+toe) which is by design.
